title: RequirementSource
description: An immutable, canonicalized snapshot of one requirement input (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, a document URL, or free text) captured into a DeliveryOrchestration (punokawan-14yn.2). canonical_key is an exact, provider-specific identifier (never a fuzzy/similar-wording match), so a pinned requirement can never be silently replaced by a similar retrieved result. Grouped into a ParentTask once routing/decomposition decides which task it belongs to. See affiliate-platform-delivery-feedback-2026-08-07.md.

external_id.description: The provider's own identifier (issue key, page id, issue/PR number); absent for freetext.

canonical_key.description: Exact dedup/pin key, e.g. "jira:PAY-1842" or "url:https://example.com/doc". Never derived from fuzzy text similarity.

parent_source_id.description: Set when this source is a Jira/GitHub subtask resolved to its source parent; the referenced RequirementSource must already exist in the same orchestration.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter; incremented on every applied event.
